subject: design/plangate-carina-adapter
statement: each `Tracker` method maps to a Carina CLI verb, addressing items by Carina id: `CreateIssue(title, body, labels, issueType)` → `carina create --type <issueType> --title --body` (returning the new id) then label application (§3.7); `LinkSubIssue(parent, child)` → `carina parent set <child> <parent>`; `AddBlockedBy(issue, blocker)` → `carina dep add <issue> <blocker>`; `Comment` → `carina comment`; `AddLabels` → per-label signal add (§3.7). The read half — `OpenIssues`, `SubIssues`, `BlockedBy`, `Comments` — reads Carina's structured `--json` output (`list`, `list --parent` once FR-19 lands / `show` rollup until then, `search` for the marker probe). The exact invocations + `--json` shapes are in the solution-shape.
